name: s153-prompt-router-git-checkout-not-billing

payload.prompt: Run git checkout -b feat/x, then skip nested git checkouts
Use a worktree checkout per agent; git checkout page-redesign first
Add zebra striped rows; who is in charge of the discharge logs?

notes: Git talk injected [Billing context]: "checkout" matched git checkout, a repo's checkouts and a worktree checkout; "stripe" matched striped; "charge" matched in charge of. Checkout now counts only as a store's, stripe only as a whole word, and in charge is dropped (discharge never matched).
